name: Vilvestre (Spain)
description: White field within a thin yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vilvestre (a tree above waves on white and a castle and cross of Saint James on yellow) above a scroll reading Villa de Vilvestre.
history: The arms of Vilvestre were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 10 May 1997; the municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, white with the arms of Vilvestre at the centre.

features.role: Vilvestre arms — tree above waves on white, castle and cross of Saint James on yellow, with scroll
